draft:
In recent year, social media become a essential part of teenager daily life. Many researcher argue that it bring both positive and negative effect for youth mental state. This study collect data from 150 student, they answer questionnaire about online usage and emotion status.

Some participant report they feel happy when they receive many like, but other said they suffered from anxiety and sleep lose. Too much scroll online will causes people compare themself with others perfect life. This research find out student spent over 4 hours each day on social platform have higher risk to get depression.

However, not all influence are bad. Online community can give support for whom feel lonely. The experiment show that limited used of social media help young people build new friendship. Because this sample size is small, the result cannot apply to all young person. Future work need more large dataset and longer observe period to verify this conclusion.
